name: coretsia/platform-worker
description: Coretsia long-running worker runtime package: worker pool orchestration, application workers, and deterministic runtime safety.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Required for graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT handling by Unix-like worker supervisors and enables the optional pcntl process driver.
suggest.ext-posix: Enables POSIX signal handling for the optional pcntl worker process driver on supported Unix-like platforms.
suggest.ext-sockets: Required on Windows for exclusive ownership of Worker retained loopback listeners through SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE.
